grammar.purpose: Name the agent responsible for an action
grammar.explanation: 活动由学生举办 names the responsible agent before the action. Compare 场地由学校管理 with a person merely attending. A delegation or representative need not be the organizer. In these agentive examples 由 does not mean because; 由于 is a separate causal expression.

examples.py: huó dòng yóu xué sheng jǔ bàn .
chǎng dì yóu xué xiào guǎn lǐ .
huì yì yóu yī wèi xué sheng zhǔ chí .

commonMistakes.wrong: 代表来了，所以活动由他举办。
commonMistakes.right: 代表来交流，举办方要另查。
commonMistakes.why: Attendance or representation does not establish responsibility.

grammar.purpose: Identify the basis for a procedure
grammar.explanation: 按名单分组 gives the grouping basis, while 按照通知上的流程签到 gives a procedural basis. 按到达时间 and 按名单 may yield different groups; read which is stated. The verb 按 in 按按钮 is press, not the preposition according to.

examples.zh: 按照通知上的流程签到。
examples.py: àn zhào tōng zhī shàng de liú chéng qiān dào .
examples.en: Sign in according to the procedure in the notice.

examples.zh: 按组发言，不按到达时间。
examples.py: àn zǔ fā yán , bù àn dào dá shí jiān .
examples.en: Speak by group, not by arrival time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 按名单分组，就是谁先到谁先说。
commonMistakes.right: 按名单分组，顺序要看名单。
commonMistakes.why: Do not replace the stated criterion with arrival order.

dialogue.title: A host, a head and a representative
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find who organizes, who hosts and how speaking turns are assigned.

lines.zh: 这次交流由谁举办？
lines.py: zhè cì jiāo liú yóu shéi jǔ bàn ?
lines.en: Who organizes this exchange?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 由学生部门举办，场地由学校管理。
lines.py: yóu xué sheng bù mén jǔ bàn , chǎng dì yóu xué xiào guǎn lǐ .
lines.en: The student department organizes it; the school manages the venue.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 部长主持吗？
lines.py: bù zhǎng zhǔ chí ma ?
lines.en: Does the department head host?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不，一位学生主持，主任确认场地。
lines.py: bù , yī wèi xué sheng zhǔ chí , zhǔ rèn què rèn chǎng dì .
lines.en: No; a student hosts, and the director confirms the venue.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们代表团怎么报到？
lines.py: wǒ men dài biǎo tuán zěn me bào dào ?
lines.en: How should our delegation report on arrival?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先在门口集中，按照通知办理手续。
lines.py: xiān zài mén kǒu jí zhōng , àn zhào tōng zhī bàn lǐ shǒu xù .
lines.en: Assemble at the entrance first and complete the formalities according to the notice.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 每组都上台吗？
lines.py: měi zǔ dōu shàng tái ma ?
lines.en: Does every entire group go on stage?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 每组派一位代表，按名单发言，每人两分钟。
lines.py: měi zǔ pài yī wèi dài biǎo , àn míng dān fā yán , měi rén liǎng fēn zhōng .
lines.en: Each group sends one representative, speaking according to the list, two minutes each.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Do four people from one group all speak?

reading.title: Read the role, not just the title
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find the difference between venue management and event hosting.

lines.zh: 活动由学生部门举办，学校负责管理场地。
lines.py: huó dòng yóu xué sheng bù mén jǔ bàn , xué xiào fù zé guǎn lǐ chǎng dì .
lines.en: The student department organizes the event; the school manages the venue.

lines.zh: 主任确认场地，学生主持会议；部长不主持。
lines.py: zhǔ rèn què rèn chǎng dì , xué sheng zhǔ chí huì yì ; bù zhǎng bù zhǔ chí .
lines.en: The director confirms the venue and a student chairs the meeting; the department head does not host.

lines.zh: 工作人员带领大家进场，所有人先在门口集中。
lines.py: gōng zuò rén yuán dài lǐng dà jiā jìn chǎng , suǒ yǒu rén xiān zài mén kǒu jí zhōng .
lines.en: Staff lead everyone in; everyone assembles at the entrance first.

lines.zh: 代表团先报到，再按照通知办理手续。
lines.py: dài biǎo tuán xiān bào dào , zài àn zhào tōng zhī bàn lǐ shǒu xù .
lines.en: The delegation reports on arrival and completes formalities according to the notice.

lines.zh: 分组和发言都按名单，不按到达的先后。
lines.py: fēn zǔ hé fā yán dōu àn míng dān , bù àn dào dá de xiān hòu .
lines.en: Grouping and speaking both follow the list, not arrival order.

lines.zh: 每组派一位代表，每人发言两分钟。
lines.py: měi zǔ pài yī wèi dài biǎo , měi rén fā yán liǎng fēn zhōng .
lines.en: Each group sends one representative who speaks for two minutes.

lines.zh: 活动流程已经确认，宣传不能把时间写错。
lines.py: huó dòng liú chéng yǐ jīng què rèn , xuān chuán bù néng bǎ shí jiān xiě cuò .
lines.en: The event procedure is confirmed; publicity must not give the wrong time.

lines.zh: 集合后先看分工，再进去。纪念活动也要按通知安排。
lines.py: jí hé hòu xiān kàn fēn gōng , zài jìn qù . jì niàn huó dòng yě yào àn tōng zhī ān pái .
lines.en: After assembling, check responsibilities before entering. A commemorative event also follows the notice.
